gaps.sentence: The finalists ___ (interview) live on air as we speak.
gaps.explanation: 'As we speak' demands the present continuous passive: are being + interviewed.
'By + future time' signals future perfect passive: will have been + processed.

gaps.sentence: The match ___ (abandon) because of the storm, so we got a refund.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive with have to: had to be + past participle for past obligation.

gaps.sentence: The original manuscript ___ (lose) for over a century.
gaps.hint: state resulting from a past passive action
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: was + lost. The person who lost it is unknown or unimportant.

gaps.sentence: The road ___ (resurface) at the time, so we took the coast route instead.
gaps.hint: in progress at a past moment
gaps.explanation: 'At the time' requires past continuous passive: was being + resurfaced.

gaps.sentence: Endangered plants ___ (not pick) anywhere in the reserve.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive of prohibition: must not be + past participle.

gaps.sentence: The theatre ___ in 1897 and reopened last year.
gaps.explanation: A finished date (1897) takes past simple passive: was + built.

gaps.sentence: The tickets ___ at the door from seven o'clock.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: can be + collected. The tickets are collected by the buyers.
